sentences.QE: What do you wish for?
sentences.AE: I wish I could travel more.
sentences.AP: Queria poder viajar mais.

sentences.AE: I want to learn how to cook.
sentences.AP: Quero aprender a cozinhar.

sentences.QE: Do you want to go out tonight?
sentences.QP: Você quer sair hoje à noite?
sentences.AE: I would like to, but I am tired.
sentences.AP: Gostaria, mas estou cansado.

sentences.AE: She wishes she had more free time.
sentences.AP: Ela queria ter mais tempo livre.

sentences.QE: What would you like to do?
sentences.QP: O que você gostaria de fazer?
sentences.AE: I would like to see a movie.
sentences.AP: Gostaria de ver um filme.

sentences.AE: I hope to visit Japan one day.
sentences.AP: Espero visitar o Japão um dia.

sentences.QE: Do you wish you had studied more?
sentences.AE: Sometimes. But I am happy now.
sentences.AP: Às vezes. Mas estou feliz agora.

sentences.AE: He wants to get a new job.
sentences.AP: Ele quer conseguir um emprego novo.

sentences.QE: What is your biggest desire?
sentences.AE: To have a family and a peaceful life.
sentences.AP: Ter uma família e uma vida tranquila.

sentences.AE: I wish it would stop raining.
sentences.AP: Queria que parasse de chover.

sentences.QE: Would you like some coffee?
sentences.AE: Yes, please. I would love some.
sentences.AP: Sim, por favor. Adoraria.

sentences.AE: They wish they could afford a house.
sentences.AP: Eles gostariam de poder comprar uma casa.

sentences.QE: What do you hope to achieve?
sentences.AE: I hope to finish my degree next year.
sentences.AP: Espero terminar minha faculdade no ano que vem.

sentences.AE: I want to be healthier.
sentences.AP: Quero ser mais saudável.

sentences.QE: Do you wish you had said something?
sentences.AE: Yes, I regret staying quiet.
sentences.AP: Sim, me arrependo de ter ficado calado.

sentences.AE: She would like to meet you.
sentences.AP: Ela gostaria de te conhecer.

sentences.QE: What would you like to eat?
sentences.QP: O que você gostaria de comer?
sentences.AE: I would like a salad, please.
sentences.AP: Gostaria de uma salada, por favor.

sentences.AE: I wish I had known earlier.
sentences.AP: Queria ter sabido antes.

sentences.QE: Do you want to change jobs?
sentences.AE: I am thinking about it.
sentences.AP: Estou pensando nisso.

sentences.AE: He hopes to get promoted soon.
sentences.AP: Ele espera ser promovido em breve.

sentences.QE: What do you desire most?
sentences.AE: Peace of mind and good health.
sentences.AP: Paz de espírito e boa saúde.

sentences.AE: I want to spend more time with my kids.
sentences.AP: Quero passar mais tempo com meus filhos.

sentences.QE: Would you like to try this?
sentences.AE: Sure, I would love to.
sentences.AP: Claro, adoraria.

sentences.AE: We wish we had more vacation days.
sentences.AP: Gostaríamos de ter mais dias de férias.

sentences.QE: What do you hope for the future?
sentences.QP: O que você espera do futuro?
sentences.AE: I hope for a better world for everyone.
sentences.AP: Espero um mundo melhor para todos.

sentences.AE: I would like to speak to the manager.
sentences.AP: Gostaria de falar com o gerente.

sentences.QE: Do you wish you could go back?
sentences.AE: Sometimes, but life goes forward.
sentences.AP: Às vezes, mas a vida segue em frente.

sentences.AE: She wants to start her own business.
sentences.AP: Ela quer abrir o próprio negócio.

sentences.QE: What would make you happy?
sentences.AE: A trip to the beach would be nice.
sentences.AP: Uma viagem à praia seria ótimo.

sentences.AE: I wish you could come to the party.
sentences.AP: Queria que você pudesse vir à festa.

sentences.QE: Do you want to learn something new?
sentences.AE: Yes, I want to learn to play guitar.
sentences.AP: Sim, quero aprender a tocar violão.

sentences.AE: He would like to work from home.
sentences.AP: Ele gostaria de trabalhar de casa.

sentences.QE: What do you long for?
sentences.AE: I long for a simpler life.
sentences.AP: Anseio por uma vida mais simples.

sentences.AE: I hope we can meet again soon.
sentences.AP: Espero que possamos nos encontrar em breve.

sentences.QE: Would you like to join us?
sentences.QP: Você gostaria de se juntar a nós?
sentences.AE: I would like to. Thank you.
sentences.AP: Gostaria. Obrigado.

sentences.AE: They want to buy a car next year.
sentences.AP: Eles querem comprar um carro no ano que vem.

sentences.QE: What is something you have always wanted?
sentences.AE: I have always wanted to write a book.
sentences.AP: Sempre quis escrever um livro.

sentences.AE: I wish I were taller.
sentences.AP: Queria ser mais alto.

sentences.QE: Do you hope to retire early?
sentences.AE: Yes, that is the plan.
sentences.AP: Sim, esse é o plano.

sentences.AE: She would love to visit Paris.
sentences.AP: Ela adoraria visitar Paris.

sentences.QE: What would you like to achieve?
sentences.QP: O que você gostaria de alcançar?
sentences.AE: I would like to speak fluent English.
sentences.AP: Gostaria de falar inglês fluente.

sentences.AE: I want to save enough to travel.
sentences.AP: Quero juntar o suficiente para viajar.

sentences.QE: Do you wish things were different?
sentences.QP: Você queria que as coisas fossem diferentes?
sentences.AE: In some ways, yes.
sentences.AP: De certa forma, sim.

sentences.AE: We would like to order now.
sentences.AP: Gostaríamos de pedir agora.

sentences.QE: What do you want from life?
sentences.QP: O que você quer da vida?
sentences.AE: Happiness and meaningful work.
sentences.AP: Felicidade e um trabalho com sentido.

sentences.AE: I wish you all the best.
sentences.AP: Desejo tudo de melhor a você.

sentences.QE: Would you like me to help?
sentences.AE: Yes, that would be great.
sentences.AP: Sim, seria ótimo.

sentences.AE: He wants to improve his English.
sentences.AP: Ele quer melhorar o inglês dele.

sentences.QE: What do you dream of doing?
sentences.QP: O que você sonha em fazer?
sentences.AE: I dream of opening a café.
sentences.AP: Sonho em abrir um café.

sentences.AE: I hope you get better soon.
sentences.AP: Espero que você melhore logo.

sentences.QE: Do you want to stay or leave?
sentences.AE: I want to stay a bit longer.
sentences.AP: Quero ficar mais um pouco.

sentences.AE: She wishes she could sing.
sentences.AP: Ela queria saber cantar.
